qa_pairs.question: What information is available to users under the "User Summary" tab in the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: Under the "User Summary" tab, users can find their quotas for various file systems, followed by a list of their last 10 jobs.

qa_pairs.question: How can a user access detailed information about their tasks from the "User Summary" tab?
qa_pairs.answer: From the "User Summary" tab, users can select a job by its number to access its detailed page. Additionally, by clicking on "(Plus de détails)", they will be redirected to the "Job Statistics" tab, where all their jobs are listed.
